content.text:
The LockingInfo table is an object table that SHALL contain exactly one row, which contains
information about the TPer's configuration.

tables.title: Table 225 LockingInfo Table Description
tables.table_md:
| Column Number | Column Name | IsUnique | Column Type |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 0x00 | UID | | uid |
| 0x01 | Name | | name |
| 0x02 | Version | | uinteger_4 |
| 0x03 | EncryptSupport | | enc_supported |
| 0x04 | MaxRanges | | uinteger_4 |
| 0x05 | MaxReEncryptions | | uinteger_4 |
| 0x06 | KeysAvailableCfg | | keys_avail_confs |
